name: design-pipeline
description: Full design-to-documentation pipeline for component changes
trigger: New component design or modification of existing component

phases.name: Design
phases.description: Define component geometry, parameters, tolerances, and print settings
phases.quality_gate: Parameters validated, fits within 256mm print volume, tolerances specified
phases.on_failure: Revise parameters based on QA feedback

phases.name: 3-View Drawing
phases.description: Create front, side, and top view technical drawings with dimensions
phases.quality_gate: All 3 views present, dimensions match component.json, tolerances annotated

phases.name: FreeCAD Implementation
phases.description: Write parametric FreeCAD Python script and generate exports
phases.quality_gate: Script executes headless without errors, STL generated, params from JSON
phases.on_failure: Fix script errors based on execution output

phases.name: BOM Update
phases.description: Update assembly and master Bills of Materials
phases.quality_gate: All parts listed, quantities correct, no orphan references

phases.name: Build Guide Update
phases.description: Update assembly instructions to reflect changes
phases.quality_gate: Instructions reference current BOM IDs, steps are clear, safety notes present
phases.on_failure: Revise instructions based on QA feedback

phases.name: QA Inspection
phases.description: Validate completeness and consistency across all outputs
phases.quality_gate: All checks pass, or specific actionable failures documented
phases.on_failure: Route back to earliest failing phase with specific feedback

retry_policy.on_fixable_failure: Update plan with pitfalls, re-enqueue at failing phase
retry_policy.on_structural_failure: Skip and document, flag for manual review
